notes: SOURCE OF THE MISATTACHED WISCONSIN EVENTS (workflow, 2026-07-03): this household (Barton, Washington Co., Wisconsin, 1860 census, five children) is the real owner of an '1860 Wisconsin residence' and '1875 naturalization' event pair that a sibling dossier found wrongly attached to an unrelated Liverpool Thomas Larkin (I182584905624), who has his own sourced 1861/1871/1881 England censuses instead. No new primary record found for this couple beyond the tree's existing citations (Find a Grave/FamilySearch blocked); a cross-node name conflation remains an open question, not confirmed.
